headlines.title: Charter’s (NASDAQ:CHTR) Q3 2026 sales beat estimates but stock drops
headlines.summary: Cable, internet and telephone services provider Charter (NASDAQ:CHTR) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with revenue up 9.1% year on year to $14.92 billion. Its GAAP loss of $20.50 per share was significantly below analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Charter Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results and Launches New Operating Model
headlines.summary: Charter Communications, Inc. (along with its subsidiaries, the "Company" or "Charter") today reported financial and operating results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, and announced a new operating model designed to return the Company to growth, unlock the full potential of its expanded scale following its acquisition of Cox Communications and capitalize on the market growth in demand for data.

headlines.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Rolls Out Managed Secure Networking For AI Heavy Enterprises
headlines.summary: Charter Communications (NasdaqGS:CHTR) has introduced Spectrum Business's Managed Cisco Secure Networking Solution, built around Cisco's 8000 Series Secure Routers. The service integrates advanced security features, including readiness for post-quantum cryptography, aimed at high-security and AI-driven enterprise environments. Spectrum Business is offering the product as a subscription-based managed networking and security service for business customers.

headlines.title: Charter Stock In Focus As Earnings Near And Internet Bundles Draw Attention
headlines.summary: Charter Communications declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.43750001 per share on its Series A Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, payable on January 15, 2027 to holders of record as of December 31, 2026.

description: Charter Communications, Inc. operates as a broadband connectivity company in the United States. The company offers subscription-based internet, mobile, video, and voice services; broadband connectivity services, including fixed internet, WiFi, and mobile; Spectrum internet products; advanced WiFi services; and in-home WiFi, which provides customers with high performance wireless routers and managed WiFi services to enhance their wireless internet experience. It also offers wireline voice communications services using voice over internet protocol technology; Call Guard, an advanced caller ID and robocall blocking solution; video programming and video services, including access to an interactive programming guide with parental controls, video on demand and pay-per-view services; and broadband communications solutions, such as internet access, data networking, fiber connectivity, video entertainment, and business telephone services. In addition, the company provides advertising services on cable television networks, various streaming services, and advertising platforms for local, regional and national businesses. Further, it offers production and technical services for regional sports networks; owns and manages local news channels, including Spectrum News NY1® and Spectrum News SoCal; and delivers broadband connectivity solutions to apartments, single-family gated communities, off-campus student housing, senior residences, and RV parks. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
